incident-bot: PagerDuty PD-8421 fired -> prod-route-proxy: 5xx rate > 3% (us-west2)
alex: @_incident-bot acked (PD-8421) — I'm on it, grabbing dashboard
jamie: @alex ping, any customer impact seen? do we have alerts throttling? :eyes:
alex: traffic looks nominal, but 5xx spike on proxy-router-3 for a ~20s window. no error logs from model pods. attaching quick snapshot:
alex: ```
# grafana snapshot
proxy_5xx_rate{route="prod-route"} spike 03:14:20-03:14:40
proxy-router-3 cpu 72% during spike
```
lee: did autoscaler do anything weird? recent scale events?
alex: autoscaler had a brief scale down on router pool 3 at 03:13:50 then scale up at 03:14:30 — looks like a narrow window where capacity dipped.
sarah: @alex can you tail the proxy logs for router-3? pattern: connection resets vs upstream 502s vs internal 5xx?
alex: tails show a handful of upstream 502s to dedicated-inference-1, then proxy returns 502 -> counted as 5xx. not seeing app OOMs.
jamie: ok sounds like transient upstream flakiness. any PD escalation? current urgency low, PD auto-resolve set to 10m, but this looks <1m. recommend suppressing noise and adjusting incidentbot hold?
lee: +1 on noise suppression. we had multiple tiny bursts last week. maybe tighten the canary sensitivity to 10s window for proxy 5xx?
sarah: for immediate mitigation: add a short routing fallback for router-3 to route to router-1,2 for 30s and increase router-3 readiness probe threshold while we investigate. alex can you run the reroute?
alex: running quick patch now: ```
# patching route to avoid router-3
kubectl patch svc prod-route -p '{"spec":{"selector":{"avoid":"router-3"}}}' --context=prod-us-west2
```
alex: patch applied, probing... :hourglass_flowing_sand:
jamie: good. monitoring for errors to drop. if resolved, mark PD resolved and document in postmortem notes.
incident-bot: PagerDuty PD-8421 auto-resolved (duration 41s) — closed by system
alex: looks clear, 5xx rate back to baseline. no customer-facing errors reported.
sarah: thanks. follow-up: create a short runbook step to warn when autoscaler down-and-up within 60s for router pools, and consider a tiny buffer to avoid scale-down thrash.
lee: adding to backlog ticket infra-882: "router autoscaler tiny-window thrash causing transient 5xx"
jamie: nice catch. can we also add the suppression tweak as a temporary on-call knob so we don't get noise during these sub-1m flares?
alex: agreed. I'll add docs and a short PR to incident-bot config to increase minimum spike window from 5s->12s for prod proxy.
sarah: :thumbsup: low-impact, ops action items assigned. closing thread once infra-882 created.
lee: infra-882 -> https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-882
jamie: sweet. thanks @alex, @sarah. :white_check_mark:
alex: np. moving to follow-up ticket now.
